source_identity: The containing commit identifies the tested tree. The only shipped-bytes change is dist/index.html; all four bundle hashes remain byte-identical to the retained build receipt.

change.before: dist/index.html called the removed `new Hydra()` constructor and ran `osc(2).out()`; Chrome reported `Hydra is not defined` and no canvas existed.
change.after: dist/index.html uses the current public bundle API: `window.HydraEffects.loadHydraEffects()`, a caller-owned 320x240 canvas, `new engine.CanvasRenderer({ canvas, basePath: window.HydraEffects.DEFAULT_CDN, bundlePath: ..., useBundles: true, preferWebGPU: false })`, `loadManifest()`, `compile('search hydra\nhydraOsc(frequency: 30, sync: 0.1, offset: 0.1).write(o0)')`, and `renderer.start()`. No bundle bytes changed (build reproduction below).

commands.command: npm pack noisemaker-for-hydra-synth && tar -xzf … into a scratch directory
commands.result: The verification ran against the packed tarball's dist/index.html and dist/hydra-synth.js, not the checkout copy
Canvas present in the served page (grep '<canvas' = 1); console logged 'example ready'; zero 'Uncaught' errors, zero 'Hydra is not defined' occurrences

commands.command: Same served page with an appended scratch probe module (packed page unmodified; the probe samples the canvas 4 times at 300 ms intervals via 2d-canvas drawImage + getImageData and writes a summary div): --dump-dom as above
commands.result: PROBE 3072|150,163,175 ; 3072|177,188,199 ; 3072|178,189,200 ; 3072|178,189,200 ; distinct=3 — four 64x48 samples (12,288 channels each) with three distinct pixel signatures, so the rendered output changes over time
commands.probe_limitation: The sampler uses 2d drawImage of the WebGL canvas; sample 4 equals sample 3 because the virtual-time budget had exhausted further frames. Changing output is claimed only as 'three distinct samples across four probes in headless Chromium'; cross-machine stability is not claimed.

commands.result: All four bundle hashes reproduced byte-for-byte (bundle reproduction required check)

acceptance.canvas: verified: <canvas id="hydra-canvas"> present in the served packed page
acceptance.changing_output: verified: three distinct 64x48 pixel samples across four probes
acceptance.zero_page_errors: verified: zero 'Uncaught' console errors and zero 'Hydra is not defined' occurrences in stderr; 'example ready' logged

limits: Verified on Linux Chromium 154 headless (SwiftShader WebGL2) only; no additional-host run.
The probe wrapper used for pixel sampling is a scratch file and is not shipped or committed.
scope: Closes GAP-004's acceptance criteria (packed-file browser execution and bundle reproduction). GAP-003's remaining release items (exact-source CI gate via GAP-005, published upgrade) are unchanged.
